traits.name: Dwarven Armor Training
traits.desc: You have proficiency with light and medium armor.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.desc: Your base walking speed is 35 feet.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.desc: You can hide when lightly obscured by natural phenomena.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks when you, the target, or what you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.desc: You know the dancing lights cantrip. At level 3 you can cast faerie fire once per long rest, and at level 5 darkness once per long rest; Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Drow Weapon Training
traits.desc: You have proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.desc: You have advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.desc: You know the minor illusion cantrip, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.desc: You can communicate simple ideas to Small or smaller beasts through sounds and gestures.
